recognize_zh: 大型淋巴瘤細胞 CD20 瀰漫膜陽性、CD10 陰性、BCL-6 與 MUM-1 核陽性、BCL-2 強陽性、c-MYC 部分核陽性且 Ki-67 很高，呈非生發中心（activated B-cell）型、MYC/BCL2 共表現的瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤免疫表型，為中樞神經原發 DLBCL 的典型組合。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei in all panels
BCL-6 and MUM-1: nuclear positivity in the majority of tumor cells
BCL-2: strong diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous positivity; c-MYC: nuclear positivity in a substantial subset (estimated ≥40%)
describe_en: Immunohistochemical panel of a diffuse large lymphoid infiltrate shows the tumor cells to be diffusely positive for CD20 and negative for CD10, with nuclear positivity for BCL-6 and MUM-1. BCL-2 is strongly and diffusely expressed, c-MYC shows nuclear staining in a substantial proportion of cells, and the Ki-67 proliferation index is high. By the Hans algorithm this is a non-germinal center B-cell–like profile with MYC/BCL2 dual expression. In a brain lesion, findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS; FISH for MYC and BCL2 rearrangement should be considered.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Protein co-expression is not equivalent to rearrangement; FISH demonstrating both MYC and BCL2 translocations is required.

ddx.dx: Systemic DLBCL with secondary CNS involvement
ddx.vs: Immunophenotype overlaps; systemic staging (PET-CT, bone marrow) excludes extracranial disease.
Burkitt lymphoma is CD10+, BCL-6+, BCL-2 negative with near-100% MYC and Ki-67 and shows a MYC translocation.
These show EBER positivity and often plasmablastic/polymorphous features in an immunocompromised host.

stain: IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL-6, MUM-1, BCL-2, c-MYC, Ki-67
